rows.name: Fisherrow
rows.description: A fixed red light on the East pier-head

rows.name: LEITH
rows.character: 1. One fixed green light 2. One fixed red light 3. One fixed bright lt.
rows.description: 1. On head of East pier 2. On inner part of E. pier, 670 yds. from extr. 3. On head of West pier. Also lights to show depth of water on Victoria Dock sill

rows.name: Newhaven
rows.description: White iron tower on E. pier. Lt. strengthened in the direction of Herwit Shoal

rows.name: Granton
rows.description: Red light on main pier-head. Green light on East and red light on West breakwater heads

rows.name: Newhalls
rows.description: A fixed bright light on inner end of pier

rows.name: South Queensferry
rows.description: A fixed bright light on end of West pier

rows.name: Inch Garvie
rows.description: Forth Bridge works. A flashing lt. ev. 5 secs. on N.W. end of Id. Red lt. at N. Queensferry, and on N. and S. sides of island; bright lt. at S. Queensferry. Also a fixed bright light on East end of each extremity of bridge

rows.name: Bo'ness
rows.description: A fixed green lt. on each pier; bright in harb.

rows.name: Grangemouth
rows.description: At entrance of River Carron, on end of South embankment. A reflected or apparent red light is also shown on North side of entrance

rows.name: Alloa
rows.description: Two fixed red lts. on pier. (Aug. 1 to April 30)

rows.name: Charleston
rows.description: One fixed red light on end of outer pier

rows.name: North Queensferry
rows.description: Fixed bright light on West pier, for ferry-boat

rows.name: Inverkeithing
rows.description: Two fixed red lights on West Quay

rows.name: St. David
rows.description: Fixed bright lt. on pier, red towards pier-head

rows.name: Burntisland
rows.description: Red lt. on E. pier-head, green lt. on W. pier. A fix. br. lt. on each of the railway piers, a short distance to the eastward, while the ferry is running. A bright light below red light on East pier, when channel is clear; a green light below red light indicates—Keep in the offing

rows.name: Kirkcaldy
rows.description: A fix. br. lt. on West pier, red lt. on East pier

rows.name: Dysart
rows.description: Fix. green lt. on E. pier, when vessels entering

rows.name: West Wemyss
rows.description: Fix. red lt. on pier-head; half-flood to half-ebb

rows.name: Buckhaven
rows.description: On East pier-head. Red tide light at foot of East pier when boats expected

rows.name: Elie
rows.description: Fixed bright light on pier. (Oct. 1 to March 1)

rows.name: St. Monans
rows.description: On pier-heads, during fishing season

rows.name: Pittenweem
rows.description: One on East pier-head, and one on a building: not shown May 15 to July 15. When boats out, a bright gas light is shown while 6 ft.

rows.name: Anstruther
rows.description: Red lt. on E. pier-head, br. lt. on W. pier-head From Oct. 1 to May 1, two fix. green lts. lead into harbour. Also a br. lt. when boats out, and 6 ft. in inner harbour, Oct. 1 to June 1

rows.name: Cellardyke
rows.description: Fix. red lt. in W. part of harb., while boats out

rows.name: Crail
rows.description: Upper red, lower bright. From old stone beacons on top of cliff. (Aug. 1 to April 30)

rows.name: North Carr Rocks
rows.description: Lightvessel proposed with fixed bright light

rows.name: ISLE OF MAY
rows.character: One 4-flash. bright light, ½ min., and one fixed bright light
rows.description: Two stone towers, 78 and 36 ft. high; low lt., fixed, 750 ft. distant, on N.E. side. In one, S.S.W., lead ½ mile E. of North Carr Rock. Low light only visible over 15° towards North Carr Rock. High light, ELECTRIC, shows 4 quick bright flashes every ½ minute

rows.name: BELL ROCK
rows.description: White tower, 117 ft. high, on the Bell Rock, base 10 ft. below high water. Light shows bright and red alternately

rows.name: St. Andrews
rows.description: Green light on pier-head, red towards entrance, and bright light on a turret in cathedral wall

rows.name: BUDDONNESS or TAY
rows.description: Two white towers, 104 and 65 ft. high, 1,200 ft. apart, on the low Ness. In line, N.W. ½ N., leads towards entrance of river

rows.name: Abertay Lightvessel
rows.description: In 5½ fathoms, opposite Abertay Spit. Painted red, with two masts
